stage2Questions.item: Does Stage 2 accept the distinction between VALIDATION DEBT (a built thing awaiting proof) and CONSTRUCTION DEBT WEARING A VALIDATION LABEL? VD-041 (Live engagement), VD-042 (public preview), VD-050 (no seek bar, no waveform, no document preview, no upload progress/cancel/retry — none of which exists) and the whole of RC-C4 are counted as validation obligations but are unbuilt product. Counting them together flatters readiness.
Should an instrument exist for founder acceptance of PRESENTATION QUALITY distinct from defect closure, below the C11 release gate (FE-9)? No obligation among the 82 asks whether anything is good.

Is a global (non scope=me) Live index intended to exist? F081, F097, F107 and CD-4 all turn on it, and building the F097-F107 preview stack over a scope=me endpoint would yield a preview with nothing to preview.

How should the fail-closed route gate (F069) and the public-first doctrine be reconciled as a PRODUCT decision rather than a code decision (BFI-11)? Correct security may currently redirect curious visitors away from public content.
Is the F064/F113 topology divergence (V2 vs V4, VDC-1) about the obligation or about the context? CR-R3 keeps both rows and VD-031 is classed UNKNOWN.

Does the RC-C5 hard gate extend to the §12 RIC stages? Stage 0 records this as NOT_RECORDED, and it determines whether media PRESENTATION may proceed while media TRUTH does — currently the two halves of one user experience are advancing at very different speeds.

PD-2 Authentication & Account Entry carries 100% of user entry with ZERO issued findings and ZERO dedicated validation obligations. Should Stage 2 treat 'zero findings' as a signal to LOOK, or as evidence of health? I argue unexamined, and flag that the evidence does not settle it.

Should the WG register's WEAK_SINGLE_SOURCE status for eleven rows (WG003, WG007, WG008, WG010-WG017) change how much weight Stage 2 gives them, given that all 17 rows originate in ONE assistant message and no WG register artifact exists in any repository?

WG012 (block boundary inside Conversation) is recommended LATER and marked WEAK_SINGLE_SOURCE, yet it is the only WG item whose absence has a direct personal-safety consequence, and the underlying blocking authority is already built and certified by C2. Does Stage 2 wish to re-read its position? (Raised as a question, NOT as an authorization request.)
Is F058 a total or partial blocker for identity imagery on web, given F051/F052 record avatars rendering live?
Was the F016 gate over F011/F014/F015 honoured, or are register dependencies advisory?
For F139, do the two same-day records describe different DIMENSIONS (structure committed, migration not applied) or genuinely conflicting states?
Is F051 one finding with a disputed state, or two surfaces with two true states?
Does the client half of F122 (conversation_screen sending DOCUMENT) still exist after RIC-C1?
Is Settings' zero finding-pressure a real signal of health, or an artefact of the surface never having been exercised?
Should Live moderation (F095) be built inside Live engagement or consumed from a Trust & Safety authority that does not yet exist?

Does the founder consider the out-of-frame 2026-08-16..18 body of work inside, alongside, or superseding the RC roadmap? (Stage 0's X2 - the largest structural gap found, and the reason RC-C10's state conflicts.)
Should PD-2 be split - structural half to CH-A Continuity, account-entry experience to CH-H Public Acquisition - rather than chartered as one surface?

FE-1 Convene the coordinated realtime human certification session (VD-046) — 20 obligations across calling and Live are held behind ONE never-convened three-identity session. This is the largest single certification bottleneck in the programme and it is a scheduling problem, not an engineering one. VDC-8 records the standing environmental dependency on the founder's browser being reachable.

FE-2 Apply the Cloudflare R2 CORS policy (VD-026 / F058) — PutBucketCors returns AccessDenied with the backend token; the JSON is already prepared. Blocks visual completion of F051, F052, F056 and WG010. In my judgement the highest visible-improvement-per-effort item in the entire register, and it is not an engineering task at all.

FE-3 Trigger a store release to unblock F071 (VD-032) — both shared-code fixes post-date the released binaries, so the native accept/reject defect cannot even be RE-OBSERVED until a release ships. Everyone who installed the app currently has a worse experience than a web visitor.

Deletion authority over live content is founder-owned.

FE-6 The three standing C2 founder checkpoints (VD-081): verification label mapping, presence privacy/visibility policy, profile visual direction. Each gates its chapter's Product-Behavior certification and no implementation may pre-empt them; the presence checkpoint intersects GAP-1's unassigned Availability Off control.

PERMITTED CLIENT INSPECTION (explicitly authorised by the task inputs: 'You may also inspect the released client under .../lib READ-ONLY to judge presentation quality'), listed here for transparency: (1) file census of aura_final/lib — 571 Dart files, largest-25 by size — reason: establish surface scale for accessibility and duplication claims.

(2) grep 'Semantics(' across lib — reason: WG015 is WEAK_SINGLE_SOURCE and an accessibility conclusion needed corroboration before being called an adoption blocker. Result: 14 occurrences across 7 files, none in Conversation, Articles, Live, Discover or any composer.

(3) targeted read of features/conversation/presentation/conversation_screen.dart around lines 1000-1070 and 1340-1400 — reason: the mission's worked example about attachment presentation required checking whether the 'ugly generic pill' is literal or hypothetical. Result: _fileChip('Attachment') renders an icon plus the hardcoded word 'Attachment', no filename/type/size/open affordance.

(4) grep for AuraMediaViewer / MediaSaveService / RichPasteField consumers across lib — reason: separate two competing interpretations of F125 (is the missing viewer a Conversation-only gap or a product-wide absence?). Result: the shared primitives exist and are consumed by feed/post cards and five legacy composers, but NOT by the canonical Conversation. This produced CD-13 and OPP-2.

(5) grep for ScrollController / loadMore / hasMore / cursor in conversation_screen.dart — reason: verify WG004's claim ('no ScrollController, loads a single page forever') because it is authorized and load-bearing for several conclusions. Result: confirmed absent.

(6) grep for emoji and typing symbols across lib — reason: distinguish 'unimplemented' from 'implemented but unexercised' for WG009 and to test whether an unregistered emoji gap exists. Result: no typing symbol anywhere; 'emoji' only in meetings/presentation/meeting_live_room_screen.dart.

(7) read of features/institutions/live_rooms/global_live_discovery.dart header and features/home/presentation/public_home_screen.dart lines 400-470 — reason: a genuine contradiction appeared between F097 (OPEN, 'Public Home does not surface real Live') and the visible existence of a live panel, and the contradiction materially affects the acquisition classification. Result: the provider is documented to 'degrade silently to an empty list when the user is not authenticated' and the endpoint is /realtime/sessions?scope=me, 'NOT a true cross-institution global feed'. This produced CD-3, CD-4 and AC-11.

(8) find for settings/support/preference/live file names — reason: assess the UNMAPPED surfaces GAP-1 and SupportScreen, which have no findings and no validation obligations at all. Result: support surfaces are scattered across features/support/, features/monetization/presentation/support_screen.dart, screens/supporters_hub_screen.dart and screens/support_fallback_screen.dart, with a user-facing name collision between customer help and financial supporters.
